title: GTA 6 Stunt Jumps: 130 of Them, and How to Find Them
short_title_options: Where are the stunt jumps in GTA 6? 🏍️ #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
GTA 6 has 130 stunt jumps and 25 BASE jumps, and they count toward 100%. Guides say you can track them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots: found ones show in purple, completed ones in white. No story spoilers. Our map: vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

Sources: PowerPyx, GTABase, GameSpot, The Click.

short_es.title: GTA 6 tiene 130 saltos acrobáticos y 25 saltos BASE, y cuentan para el 100%. Según las guías, se ven en el mapa, en Exploración y luego Stunt Spots. Fuentes: PowerPyx, GTABase, GameSpot, The Click.
